title: count() SQL query avoids materializing all IDs — correct approach
description: Replacing list_ids().len() with a COUNT(*) SQL query is correct. The old code fetched all chat IDs into a Vec just to call .len(), which allocates O(n) strings even though only the count is needed. A future contributor might revert to list_ids().len() thinking it simplifies code — it does not: it makes calculateTotal=true O(n) in allocations for no reason. The COUNT(*) query is the right tool.
